source_note: Compiled from official notices and mainstream reporting. Every card links to its original source.

items.title: New Zealand opens 5,000 work visas for Indians
items.summary: New Zealand has announced 5,000 work visa places available for Indian nationals. The report outlines who is eligible to apply and the conditions that apply to these visa opportunities.

items.title: US EAD rule change may put jobs at risk with expired work permits
items.summary: A change to US Employment Authorization Document rules is explained, with warnings that workers holding expired permits could face employment risks. The new policy affects how work authorization is maintained.

items.title: EB-5 visa minimum investment threshold set to increase in 2027
items.summary: The minimum investment amount required for the US EB-5 investor visa programme will rise in 2027. The increase will affect aspiring immigrants planning to use this investment-based immigration route.

items.title: Canada drops LMIA requirement for eligible Express Entry job offers
items.summary: Canada has removed the Labour Market Impact Assessment requirement for certain job offers submitted through Express Entry. The change simplifies the process for eligible applicants with qualifying employment offers.

items.title: Express Entry rules change from November 3, CRS scores may be affected
items.summary: Canada's Express Entry system will see rule changes taking effect from November 3. The modifications are expected to impact how Comprehensive Ranking System scores are calculated for applicants.

items.title: Student visa refusals surge in New Zealand
items.summary: New Zealand is reportedly experiencing a sharp increase in the number of student visa applications being refused. The trend marks a significant shift in approval rates for international students.

items.title: Australia tightens student visa rules for Indian students
items.summary: Australia has introduced stricter student visa requirements. The changes are expected to affect Indian students planning to study in Australia, though specific details of the new rules have not been disclosed in this report.

items.title: Major IT firms reduce H-1B lottery registrations amid tighter US visa rules
items.summary: Infosys, TCS and Cognizant have reduced their H-1B lottery registrations as the Trump administration tightens US visa regulations. The move reflects changing immigration policies affecting Indian IT professionals seeking to work in the United States.

items.title: Indian doctors and engineers gain edge under Canada's new immigration rules
items.summary: Canada has introduced new immigration rules that reportedly give Indian doctors and engineers an advantage in the application process. The changes affect how these professionals are assessed for entry.

items.title: UK considers new investor visa for wealthy foreigners ahead of October budget
items.summary: The United Kingdom is reportedly considering introducing a new investor visa category aimed at wealthy foreign nationals. The proposal is being discussed in advance of the October budget announcement.

items.title: Canada revives Express Entry job offer points for high-wage workers
items.summary: Canada has reinstated points for job offers in its Express Entry system. Indian workers holding high-wage job offers could benefit from improved ranking scores under the restored points allocation.

items.title: H-1B spouse visa: Complete guide to H-4 eligibility and work permits
items.summary: A comprehensive guide for Indians covers H-4 visa eligibility for spouses of H-1B holders, including work permit options and rules governing length of stay in the United States.

items.title: US more than doubles EB-5 investor visa fees
items.summary: The United States has more than doubled the fees for the EB-5 investor visa programme. The significant fee increase will affect investors, including those from India, seeking US permanent residence through the investment immigration pathway.

items.title: US tightens work permit renewal rules for H-4 spouses
items.summary: New US immigration rules have made work permit renewals more difficult for H-4 visa holders, who are spouses of H-1B workers. The tighter regulations are expected to affect many Indian families living and working in the United States.

items.title: 64% of Indian students denied Ireland visas despite university admissions
items.summary: A reported 64 per cent of Indian students have been denied Ireland visas even after receiving university admissions. The rejections are reportedly linked to concerns over AI-generated documents, creating obstacles for students with confirmed university places.

items.title: Canada to revamp Express Entry points system from November 3
items.summary: Canada will revamp its Express Entry points system starting November 3. The changes are expected to affect Indian applicants seeking permanent residence through the Express Entry pathway, though the specific impact remains to be seen.

items.title: US scraps 540-day work permit extension, risking job disruptions
items.summary: The US has eliminated the 540-day work permit extension, putting Indian workers and their spouses at risk of job disruptions. The change affects those awaiting work authorization renewals and could create employment gaps during processing periods.

items.title: Canada to revamp Express Entry points from November 3
items.summary: Canada will implement changes to its Express Entry points system starting November 3. The revamped scoring criteria could affect how Indian applicants are assessed for permanent residence through the popular immigration pathway.

items.title: US scraps 540-day work permit extension for workers and H-4 spouses
items.summary: The US has eliminated the 540-day automatic extension for work permits, affecting both certain visa holders and H-4 spouses. This change reportedly puts workers at risk of job disruptions if their permit renewals are not processed before current authorization expires.

items.title: UK visa rules cause decline in foreign students from India and Pakistan
items.summary: Recent changes to UK visa regulations have led to a decline in the number of foreign students arriving from India and Pakistan. The stricter rules appear to be affecting student enrolment from these two countries significantly.

items.title: US immigration fees rise effective today for work permits and other benefits
items.summary: New, higher immigration fees have come into effect in the United States for work permits and various other immigration benefits. The increase will affect Indians applying for these services, raising the cost of applications.

items.title: US judge orders Trump administration to reopen Green Card lottery by November 1
items.summary: A US judge has ordered the Trump administration to reopen the Green Card lottery programme by November 1. The court ruling requires the government to resume accepting applications for the diversity visa lottery.

items.title: US ends 540-day work permit extensions, affecting H-1B spouses
items.summary: The United States has ended the 540-day automatic extension for work permits, a change that will particularly affect spouses of H-1B visa holders. H-4 visa holders with employment authorisation will now face shorter extension periods.

items.title: US immigration fee hike takes effect today
items.summary: New increased fees for US immigration applications came into force today. The fee hike affects various visa categories and immigration benefits that Indian applicants commonly use, making the application process more expensive than before.

items.title: Will the US freeze on green card applications affect Indian IT companies and employees?
items.summary: A reported freeze on green card applications in the United States is raising concerns about potential impacts on Indian IT sector companies and their employees. The article examines how this development could affect Indian professionals seeking permanent residency.

items.title: US tightens immigration rules, ends auto renewal of work permits for H-4 spouses
items.summary: The United States has ended the automatic renewal provision for work permits issued to H-4 visa holders, who are spouses of H-1B workers. This tightening of immigration rules means H-4 dependants will face additional requirements to maintain work authorization.

items.title: US ends automatic work permit renewal for H-4 spouses
items.summary: The United States has tightened immigration rules and stopped the automatic renewal of work permits for H-4 visa holders, who are spouses of H-1B workers. This change affects how H-4 dependants maintain their employment authorization in the US.

items.title: US immigration fee hike takes effect: higher charges for Indians
items.summary: New US immigration fees have come into effect, with higher charges for various visa categories and applications. The fee increase impacts Indians applying for work permits, visas and other immigration benefits in the United States.

items.title: USCIS proposes ending prior approval deference for H-1B visa extensions
items.summary: US immigration authorities have proposed eliminating the practice of deferring to prior approvals when processing H-1B visa extension applications. This proposed change could mean more scrutiny and potentially different outcomes for renewal applicants compared to current procedures.

items.title: USCIS changes weekend filing rules for visa and green card applicants
items.summary: US Citizenship and Immigration Services has modified its rules regarding applications filed on weekends. The change affects how filing deadlines are calculated for visa and green card applicants, requiring them to understand the new weekend submission procedures.

items.title: Canada citizenship certificate wait rises to 34 months
items.summary: Processing times for Canadian citizenship certificates have increased to 34 months, though the application backlog has fallen for the first time in recent years. The lengthy wait affects those who have applied for proof of citizenship.

items.title: New USCIS deadline rules for visa and green card applicants from Oct 23
items.summary: US Citizenship and Immigration Services is implementing new deadline rules from October 23 that will affect visa and green card applicants. The changes relate to how deadlines are calculated and applied for immigration applications and responses.

items.title: US visa rule change may cause longer waits for H-1B workers, Indian students
items.summary: A reported US visa rule change may lead to longer processing times for H-1B workers and Indian students, even when applicants pay premium processing fees. The change could affect those expecting expedited decisions. Wait times may increase despite the additional cost.

items.title: UK visa curbs hit university offers: What prospective students must know
items.summary: UK visa restrictions are affecting university admission offers to international students. Prospective students need to understand how the tighter visa rules impact their applications and what steps to take. The curbs have led to changes in how universities handle offers to foreign applicants.

items.title: Canada citizenship certificate wait rises to 34 months as backlog falls
items.summary: Processing times for Canadian citizenship certificates have increased to 34 months, even as the application backlog has declined for the first time since December 2025. Applicants should expect lengthy waits despite improvements in clearing pending cases. The wait time affects those seeking proof of citizenship.

items.title: UK universities withdrawing admissions offered to Indian, Pakistani applicants
items.summary: Some UK universities are reportedly withdrawing admission offers previously made to Indian and Pakistani students. The withdrawals are linked to stricter visa rules now in place. Prospective students who received offers may need to understand how the new regulations affect their applications.

items.title: What US green card policy really costs India's IT industry
items.summary: An analysis examines the impact of US green card policies on India's information technology sector. Long waiting times and quota restrictions are reported to affect Indian IT professionals and the companies that employ them. The policies have broader economic implications for the industry.

items.title: UK universities withdraw student offers amid stricter visa rules
items.summary: Some UK universities are reported to be withdrawing admission offers previously made to Indian students. The withdrawals are linked to stricter visa rules and rising refusal rates affecting international applicants from India and other countries.

items.title: US ends 540-day automatic work permit extension for immigrants
items.summary: The United States has ended the 540-day automatic extension of work permits for certain immigrants. The change affects how long work authorization remains valid while renewal applications are pending with immigration authorities.

items.title: India-Switzerland mobility pact explained: Visas, work and study rules
items.summary: India and Switzerland have signed a mobility pact covering visa, work and study arrangements between the two countries. The agreement is expected to ease movement for students, workers and professionals. Details explain how the pact will affect travel and residence rules.

items.title: US visa and green card applicants face new filing deadline rules from Oct 23
items.summary: New filing deadline rules for US visa and green card applicants take effect from 23 October. The changes affect how and when applicants must submit their immigration paperwork to US authorities.

items.title: New USCIS deadline rules: What green card and H-1B applicants must know
items.summary: US Citizenship and Immigration Services has introduced new deadline rules affecting green card and H-1B visa applicants. The changes tighten timelines for filing and responding to immigration requests and notices.

items.title: New USCIS rules tighten deadlines for Green Card and H-1B applicants
items.summary: United States Citizenship and Immigration Services has introduced new rules that tighten deadlines for Green Card applicants and H-1B workers. The changes affect filing requirements and timelines for these visa categories, though specific details of the modifications have not been disclosed in this report.

items.title: UK universities withdraw admission offers as visa refusals rise for Indian students
items.summary: Universities in the United Kingdom are reportedly withdrawing admission offers to Indian students as visa refusal rates increase. The trend appears linked to tighter student visa rules being implemented, affecting students who had already received university acceptance letters for study programmes.

items.title: US visa rule change: Weekend timing could affect Green Card applicant eligibility
items.summary: A change to United States visa rules means that weekend timing could impact eligibility for some Green Card applicants. The modification to how deadlines are calculated may cause some applicants to lose their eligibility depending on whether key dates fall on weekdays or weekends.

items.title: UAE's five-year multiple-entry tourist visa rules for Indian travellers
items.summary: The UAE offers a five-year multiple-entry tourist visa option for Indian travellers. The report explains the rules, requirements and conditions that Indian passport holders need to know when applying for this long-term tourist visa.

items.title: UK student visa applications fall 16% as August total drops below 100,000
items.summary: Student visa applications to the UK declined by 16 per cent, with the August total falling below 100,000. The drop reflects changing patterns in international student applications to British universities and colleges.

items.title: Switzerland visas for Indians: New mobility pact vs young professionals scheme
items.summary: A new mobility pact between India and Switzerland is compared with the existing young professionals scheme. The report explains how the two visa pathways differ for Indians seeking to work or study in Switzerland.

items.title: PERM ban affects green card path beyond H-1B workers
items.summary: A reported ban on PERM labour certification affects not only H-1B visa holders but also other categories of workers seeking permanent residency in the United States. The change impacts the green card pathway for multiple visa categories that rely on employer sponsorship through the PERM process.

items.title: Indian students in Australia face challenges with rent, jobs and visa concerns
items.summary: Indian students studying in Australia are encountering difficulties navigating high rental costs, employment challenges and visa-related worries. The report suggests that the experience on the ground is proving harder than the initial promise that attracted students to choose Australia for their education.

items.title: UK universities withdraw admission offers to Indian students as visa refusals rise
items.summary: Some UK universities are reported to be withdrawing admission offers to students from India, Pakistan and Nigeria. The withdrawals are linked to rising visa refusal rates affecting applicants from these countries.

items.title: Dubai family visa salary requirements for bringing spouse, children or parents
items.summary: The article outlines the minimum salary requirements for Indians working in Dubai who wish to sponsor family members on a UAE family visa, including spouses, children or parents.

items.title: New Zealand employer work visa reset: Detail less dramatic than it sounds
items.summary: New Zealand First has announced changes to employer work visa rules that initially sound significant. However, the actual detail of the policy reset is reported to be less revolutionary than the announcement suggests.

items.title: Infosys says green card suspension will have no material impact on operations
items.summary: Infosys has stated that the reported suspension of green card processing will not materially affect its business. The article explains what Indian employees and applicants should understand about the current situation.

items.title: Canada PR for Indians: Who benefits from the new immigration rules?
items.summary: Canada has introduced new immigration rules affecting permanent residency applications. The article examines which categories of Indian applicants are likely to benefit from the updated policy framework.

items.title: US probes nine universities over J-1 exchange visas amid tighter student rules
items.summary: The US administration is reportedly investigating nine universities regarding their J-1 exchange visa programmes. The probe comes as part of tightened regulations affecting international students under the current administration.

items.title: Green card freeze: Impact on Indian IT companies and alternative options
items.summary: The reported green card freeze is expected to affect certain Indian IT companies and their employees more than others. The article discusses which firms face the greatest impact and explores alternative visa or relocation options.

items.title: UK student visa crackdown leaves international applicants caught between parties
items.summary: International student visa applicants to the UK are reportedly caught in difficulties between universities and the Home Office due to an ongoing visa crackdown. The situation is creating uncertainty for prospective students.

items.title: US tightens visa and green card rules for Indian tech workers
items.summary: The United States has reportedly tightened visa and green card regulations, prompting Indian technology professionals to consider alternative destinations for overseas employment and permanent residency. The article suggests five other countries as potential options for Indian tech workers.

items.title: US green card move reported to affect thousands of IT workers
items.summary: A recent US green card policy change is reported to impact thousands of IT workers. The move has been described in terms suggesting significant consequences for workers in the technology sector seeking permanent residency in the United States.
